title: AUTH-3 Bounded Execute: in-cap action permitted, over-cap action routes to approval
risk: An agent executes an action above the tenant autonomy limit without human approval, or a within-limit action is wrongly blocked, breaking throughput or governance.
preconditions: Namespace gov-unit-auth-<case_id>-<worker_id>; no shared mutable state with other cases.

assertions: The boundary is inclusive: reminder_count 2 permits, reminder_count 3 does not.
An undefined policy limit never means unlimited: the action is routed to approval rather than executed.
Adapter dispatch counter is exactly 1 across all three actions.
LIMIT_EXCEEDED and REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL are distinct decision codes on the two blocked actions.
forbidden: Treating an unset limit as unlimited and executing the broadcast.
Silently dropping the over-cap message instead of returning a typed decision and routing it.
Reusing the within-cap action result as the over-cap result (mock echo).
